description:
BF16 Q + E4M3 KV、inline FP32 token/head scales → BF16 O. Prepared Q/KV/scales/index metadata -> QK -> softmax -> PV -> native outputs; excludes projection/RoPE/cache writer. HD64/128/256, MHA/GQA/MQA, page16/32/64/128, HND/NHD; prefill/prefix/decode/MTP, global bottom-right causal, O-only.

Production entry: vllm.v1.attention.ops.triton_unified_attention.unified_attention; fixed source revision source-sha256:5061988dfa16d44fe28763093552d45547985397f1335449bbcc89de936d5a65.

Parameter domain: shape_range.json defines dynamic request ranges and correlated model/ABI constraints; shape_cases.json fixes 10 representative workloads, not the complete support domain. Q and KV lengths vary per request; equal batch lengths and 0<Q_i<=KV_i are enforced. Head geometry is a correlated model/TP tuple; it is independent of request length and input stress profile. No measured traffic weights are claimed. Existing GPU evidence covers only the unchanged fixed sample, not every point in this dynamic domain.

Input construction: Retain prepared production payload/scale, strides, page tables, aliases and QDQ. Q/K/V now share a synthetic latent family: four topics, eight fixed sinusoidal projection components, independent token innovations, per-head gains .65..1.35 and channel gains .7..1.3. Q and K topic affinity creates nonuniform attention, and K/V share latent topic features. In absorbed MLA, V remains the actual first 512 components of stored K; D576 keeps a separate 64-channel RoPE-amplitude component, while the distinct D512 interface stays D512. No hidden unquantized truth enters the reference. Existing tiny/peaked/zero/cancellation and scale controls are preserved after construction. These are declared synthetic projection statistics, not observed model weights or traffic.

Numerical contract reference-materialization-v1-20261013: Per-token/head FP8 KV with independent FP32 QK and BF16 weighted P.

For each 32-key normalization group, apply K scale after QK, and round
P * V_scale to BF16 before PV against the stored V payload. The softmax
denominator uses unrounded P. Grouping specifies numerical semantics,
not a required candidate kernel schedule. Independent FP32 between stated QDQ/storage boundaries, TF32 disabled. No native approximate exp/reciprocal instructions define reference truth. Prior reference and contract: evidence/reference-revision-20261013/before.tar.gz. Source basis: docs/production-bench-v3/CORE_NUMERICAL_ATTRIBUTION_20261013.md.
